title: Sad Emoji & Kaomoji: Copy & Paste 😢 Sad Face Combos
meta_description: Sad emoji 😢 😔 for melancholy bios and captions, heartbroken 💔 combo sets, and down-mood kaomoji like (μ_μ) in one library.
hero_tagline: Melancholy faces, heartbreak symbols, and gloomy kaomoji for sad bios, captions, and late-night posts. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: A sad emoji says what a paragraph can't: 😢 for a single tear, 😔 for quiet pensiveness, 💔 for outright heartbreak. This library covers the whole melancholy spectrum: classic sad faces, wilted-rose heartbreak symbols beloved by sad-aesthetic bios, drained and disappointed expressions, and downcast kaomoji like (μ_μ). For full-on sobbing and tears, head to the crying emoji page instead.

editorial_sections.h2: Why there are so many sad emojis
paragraphs: Unicode did not add more than a dozen sad faces by excess: each one filled a use the existing ones did not cover. 😞 comes from the early Japanese emoji sets. 🥺 was added much later and almost at once became a sign of coaxing more than of sadness. 🫠 and 🫤 arrived in 2021 and mean exhaustion rather than grief. The gap between Unicode's names and how the faces are really used is why this page orders them by intensity, not by when they were added.
